purpose: pytest coverage for Movie loading and default placeholder state. It builds temporary encoded movie files to verify frame count, display timing, padding, centering, and single-load behavior.
invariants: Test fixture files must follow the 14-line encoded movie chunk format.
Movie.load remains single-use and returns False on a second load attempt.
Loaded frame lines remain padded to left_margin + _frame_width.
gotchas: write_movie is a local test helper, not production API.
